pipeline_steps.name: Hardware Discovery
pipeline_steps.short_description: Detects CUDA devices, driver levels, CPU architecture, and recommended PyTorch wheel index.
pipeline_steps.long_description: Performs low-level hardware probing to identify NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA capabilities, cuDNN and TensorRT libraries, and system topology to pick the optimal PyTorch distribution.

pipeline_steps.name: Toolchain Audit
pipeline_steps.short_description: Verifies Python 3.12, Git, Node.js LTS, and toolchain prerequisites.
pipeline_steps.long_description: Checks foundational toolchains including active Python interpreter version, Git availability, and required build tools before running workspace transformations.

pipeline_steps.name: Virtual Environments
pipeline_steps.short_description: Discovers and reconciles isolated .venv environments and node_modules across all projects.
pipeline_steps.long_description: Inspects each managed project in the workspace, validates virtual environment structures, checks interpreter binaries, and ensures node_modules directories exist.

pipeline_steps.name: Requirements Sync & Install
pipeline_steps.short_description: Propagates centralized SSOT manifests, installs package wheels, and normalizes OpenCV.
pipeline_steps.long_description: Synchronizes shared dependency declarations from centralized manifests, runs deterministic pip wheel installations with accelerator indices, and pins unified OpenCV providers.

pipeline_steps.name: Dependency Audit & Upgrades
pipeline_steps.short_description: Audits outdated packages, detects version drift, and applies safe non-breaking upgrades.
pipeline_steps.long_description: Scans installed packages against PyPI and npm registries, verifies reverse-dependency constraints, and applies verified safe semver upgrades.

pipeline_steps.name: Codebase Verification
pipeline_steps.short_description: Compiles Python bytecode, verifies syntax, and enforces zero-emoji compliance.
pipeline_steps.long_description: Runs py_compile across all Python sources, validates YAML and JSON schemas, audits markdown compliance, and checks for zero emoji violations across every repository.

pipeline_steps.name: Health Matrix
pipeline_steps.short_description: Generates complete ecosystem health report and evaluates overall system integrity.
pipeline_steps.long_description: Compiles complete cross-project audit matrix covering environment statuses, package counts, missing libraries, and operational health verdicts.
